claim: Scoped distance-weighted communication bound on uniform diagonal permutation family: (s+O(1))*E[T_local]+(a+O(1))*E[sum_j Delta_j] >= D*log2(r!)-O(D). Example input IDs are illustrative; bound is distributional, not pointwise on example.
proof: For each middle cut two-party simulation sends finite control state on crossings, a-bit address plus returned bit for remote immutable input queries spanning cut. Diagonal transcripts distinct by rectangle property, prefix-free encoding yields average >= log2(r!). Sum over cuts; sum C_c<=T_local, sum J_c=sum Delta_j. With fixed Q and no remote reads gives quadratic time and input-inclusive cubic CM. Free random access escapes; no general lower bound.
checker: Symbolic proof in report.md @f002c375649e487291f7e8460e87d11801cbf22d; executable schedule audit transport-access.js @97378ed252e791646a0723b42f6a38f31a7e3a43 and manifest generation as described; not a formal kernel.
scope: Exact deterministic one-head tape, remote immutable-input bit queries; address computed locally, no free hidden memory. R=256 example, N=98336 logical bits, 18287 cuts, 2816 field bits per side; schedule comparison excludes parsing and full TM step count.
